tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student who recently attended a guest lecture by Professor Johnson on environmental sustainability. You found the lecture very insightful and would like to learn more about the topic. Write an email to Professor Johnson.
bullets: Express your appreciation for the lecture and highlight what you found most interesting.
Explain why you are interested in learning more about environmental sustainability.
Request additional reading materials and resources related to the topic.
tasks.subject: Request for additional resources on environmental sustainability
